SS27 · Collection 04 · Saturation

WEAR THE colour OUT LOUD

Six silhouettes. Twelve dyes. Mixed by hand in Bagru and cut in Jaipur, in runs of 48 pieces per colourway.

Shop the drop → Scroll

Saturation SS27 — filmed in the dye yard

Tailoring Cobalt Streetwear Lagoon Evening Orchid Knitwear Marigold Resort Poppy Denim Indigo Tailoring Cobalt Streetwear Lagoon Evening Orchid Knitwear Marigold Resort Poppy Denim Indigo

Every style, one saturation

Six arches, six moods — tailoring through denim, each dyed in the same Jaipur vats.

The wardrobe, in the round

Drag the ring — scroll nudges it forward. The front piece reads its fabric and price.

Style rails

Horizontal rails per silhouette — hover to pause, drag to fling.

Tailoring4 pieces
Streetwear4 pieces
Evening4 pieces
Knitwear4 pieces
Resort4 pieces
Denim4 pieces

01

Cobalt structure

Double-faced cashmere cut sharp, dyed in three dips until the blue reads almost electric.

02

Evening orchid

Bias slip in 19 momme silk — the hem moves like water under Jaipur streetlight.

03

Marigold knit

Lambswool cardigan set, marigold from Bagru tagetes, paired with chalk alpaca.

04

Lagoon fleece

Brushed loop-back and fleece in lagoon green — streetwear washed in the same vat as tailoring.

05

Resort block

Hand-block voile dress; six days per print run, forty-eight pieces then the screen rests.

06

Indigo denim

14 oz selvedge overdyed cobalt on the trucker — raw edge, saturated seam.

Cobalt

HL-04/01 · Indigo vat, 3 dips

One dye pot.

function hlPad(n: number) {
  return String(n).padStart(2, '0')
}

export function hlViewsForImages(images: string[]): HlProductView[] {
  const main = images[0]
  const list: HlProductView[] = [{ type: 'full', asset: main, pos: '50% 50%' }]
  list.push({ type: 'detail-upper', asset: main, pos: '50% 18%' })
  list.push({ type: 'detail-lower', asset: main, pos: '50% 82%' })
  if (images[1]) {
    list.push({ type: 'alt', asset: images[1], pos: '50% 50%' })
  }
  return list
}

export function hlBuildProducts(): HlProduct[] {
  const all: HlProduct[] = []
  HL_STYLES.forEach((style) => {
    style.items.forEach((item, idx) => {
      const [name, fabric, price, colour, images] = item
      const code = `HL-${style.code}-${hlPad(idx + 1)}`
      all.push({
        code,
        styleCode: style.code,
        styleLabel: style.label,
        styleTint: style.tint,
        name,
        fabric,
        price,
        colour,
        colourHex: HL_PALETTE[colour as HlColourName] || '#6a6773',
        images,
        views: hlViewsForImages(images),
      })
    })
  })
  return all
}

export const HL_ALL = hlBuildProducts()
export const HL_BY_CODE = Object.fromEntries(HL_ALL.map((p) => [p.code, p])) as Record<
  string,
  HlProduct
>

export function hlByCode(code: string): HlProduct {
  return HL_BY_CODE[code] ?? HL_BY_CODE['HL-T-01']
}

export function hlFormatPrice(n: number) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: 'INR',
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(n)
}

export function hlSrc(name: string, ext?: string, base = HL_DEFAULT_ASSET_BASE) {
  if (name === 'hero-main') {
    return ext === 'poster' ? `${base}/hero-poster.jpg` : `/hueline/hero-main.${ext || 'webm'}`
  }
  if (name === 'dye-yard') {
    return `${base}/dye-yard.${ext || 'webm'}`
  }
  if ((HL_VIDEOS as readonly string[]).includes(name)) {
    return `${base}/${name}.${ext || 'webm'}`
  }
  if ((HL_ASSETS as readonly string[]).includes(name)) {
    if (ext === 'jpg' || !ext) return `${base}/${name}.jpg`
  }
  return `${base}/${name}.${ext || 'jpg'}`
}
